## Requirements: Materialize the Spatial Relationship rhythm tokens in Web/App design sources

### Background
#4045 delivered a canonical design *document*, not executable spacing tokens. The user called out the gap: existing `--nession-shell-space-1..5` and `--nession-panel-padding` provide raw amounts, yet shared content recipes still repeat `gap-5`, `gap-2`, `gap-1` and `gap-1.5` as their own styling choices. Documentation-only completion does not prove that product UI consumes a single design system.

### Scope and decisions
- Introduce a **minimal, cross-Experience `rhythm` semantic metric family** in canonical `design/tokens/experience/{web,app}.json`, generated into **the existing `--nession-*` API** and App generated TS. Reuse current established pixel values in this first consumer migration to avoid an unverified cosmetic redesign.
- Proven shared relationships: `sectionStack` (between major content groups; baseline 20px), `sectionContent` (section heading/body; baseline 8px), `textStack` (title/context, related small vertical stacks; baseline 4px), `inline` (label/icon/fact/inline actions; baseline 8px), and `fieldStack` (label/control/help/error; baseline 6px). The 6px field rhythm is an established shadcn-compatible exception, not a new primitive scale.
- Web/App use the **same semantic names**, distinct Experience ownership; identical values are intentional baseline rather than proof the Experiences can never diverge. Preserve `panel.padding` 12px Web / 16px App and `control` hit/visual metrics as already tokenized; do not create duplicates or arbitrary `--aw-*`.
- Consume new metrics in genuinely shared UI recipes: `ResourceDetail`, `ConfigurationForm`, `OperationSurface`, and the shared `Label` primitive where the same relationship is already represented. Leave special renderer geometry, `Button` upstream 6px icon gap, and context-specific form row/section variants until separate proven need; no broad raw-gap ban.
- Ensure generated outputs **match the canonical generator exactly**: `web.css`, `app.ts`, `lint-metadata.json` regenerated and `token-generated-integrity` Gate passes. No runtime pixel shift is expected for converted relationships.
- Link #3971 as downstream App consumer; this requirement does not claim #3971 UX / screenshot acceptance.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 Same `rhythm` token roles exist in canonical Web/App Experience source and all generated artifacts pass exact codegen integrity; no second variable namespace or duplicated panel/control scale.
- [x] SC-02 The five token roles are consumed by at least two independent shared content recipes and inline Label; no token left unused, and preexisting corresponding component box gap values are preserved for Web and App.
- [ ] SC-03 Source-aligned Quality/Gate checks succeed at the exact PR head; existing UI/browser checks appropriate to the changed shared source remain green. No screenshot/computed-style Pass is inferred from documentation alone.

### SC scenario and proof
- SC-01/SC-02: SCN-01 deterministic source/codegen contract at PR head, agent evidence from `token-generated-integrity`, compiled CSS and audited consumer imports/classes.
- SC-03: SCN-02 Web/App interaction/visual regression source-aligned **existing Chromium E2E** plus PR Quality, agent may assess only authenticated CI/browser assertion receipts, not self-attest rendered pixels.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr

```
